SEARCH
Package com.nexuslink.protocol.ldap

Interface LdapFilter

All Known Implementing Classes:
LdapFilter.And, LdapFilter.Approx, LdapFilter.Equality, LdapFilter.ExtensibleMatch, LdapFilter.GreaterOrEqual, LdapFilter.LessOrEqual, LdapFilter.Not, LdapFilter.Or, LdapFilter.Present, LdapFilter.Substring
public sealed interface LdapFilter permits LdapFilter.And, LdapFilter.Or, LdapFilter.Not, LdapFilter.Present, LdapFilter.Equality, LdapFilter.Substring, LdapFilter.GreaterOrEqual, LdapFilter.LessOrEqual, LdapFilter.Approx, LdapFilter.ExtensibleMatch
Typed, immutable model of an RFC 4515 LDAP search filter. Instances are produced by LdapFilterParser.parse(String) and can render() themselves back into a valid, equivalent filter string (a parse → render round-trip).

This is the inverse of LdapFilterBuilder, which composes filter strings from simple rows. Assertion values are held in decoded form (all \HH escapes from RFC 4515 §3 resolved) and are re-escaped on render() using the same rule as the builder (* ( ) \ NUL → \HH), so a rendered filter is always well-formed.

Grammar reference (RFC 4515 §2): 

   filter     = "(" filtercomp ")"
   filtercomp = and / or / not / item
   and        = "&" filterlist
   or         = "|" filterlist
   not        = "!" filter
   item       = simple / present / substring / extensible
